job.title: Architecting Long-Context LLM Acceleration with Packing-Prefetch Scheduler and Ultra-Large Capacity On-Chip Memories
job.selection_reason: packing-prefetch schedulerと512MB級BEOL on-chip memoryをco-designし、long-context KV transferをcomputeと重畳。Llama3.1-8Bでdecode 8.06x、overall latency 1.83x、multi-request throughput 1.7-2.4xを報告し、prefetchとmemory hierarchyのhardware/runtime接点として有用。
